testCases.input: What does the author mean by the two rivers running through us?
testCases.actualOutput: generator not evaluated in this run
testCases.expectedOutput: The author says two rivers run through us at all times. The first river carries all the voices of the world, and it is strong, steady, and constant with its instruction, guidance, and forewarning. The second river is a single voice that stands alone, which is the voice of our inner guide. Most of us live mindlessly, being pulled toward each milestone we were told to reach for, until we look down and realize our hands are empty. The author says the journey is not about abandoning one river in favor of the other. The journey is about knowing when it is time to listen to, hear, and follow each of them. Our lives begin the day we choose to follow our inner knowing, even while still hearing, and at times heeding, the collective knowledge of the first river.
